topic_desc: SPECIALIST: The Old Forge was built by the first smiths; its fire is fed by a vent of the mountain and never cools. Smiths say steel tempered there sings.
topic_desc_basic: The Old Forge is the big forge above town where the best swords are made.

topic_desc: SPECIALIST: Pine-needle tea is brewed from young needles steeped for exactly four minutes; alchemists use it to steady the hand.
topic_desc_basic: Pine-needle tea is a bitter drink smiths like in the cold.

topic_desc: SPECIALIST: Frost trolls regenerate unless burned; their fat is an alchemy ingredient.
topic_desc_basic: Frost trolls are huge white beasts of the snowy peaks. Stay away.

topic_desc: SPECIALIST: The Hidden Name is a secret rite in which a smith takes a second name known only to the forge.
topic_desc_basic: You have heard rumors of a smiths' naming rite, nothing more.

topic_desc: SPECIALIST: Kyne, the Nordic aspect of Kynareth, is goddess of storms and the sky, widow of Shor.
topic_desc_basic: Kyne is the Nord goddess of the sky and storms. Hunters pray to her.

topic_desc: SPECIALIST: The Sleeping Tavern's cellar connects to the old smugglers' tunnels.
topic_desc_basic: The Sleeping Tavern is the busy inn by the gate; warm food and gossip.
